purpose: Find source-grounded downstream effects not already direct correction targets, and conclusions with independently retained support. Preserve v10 redundant-propagation controls.
source_rule: Primary sources for admission. Preserve actual queries, results, inaccessible sources, overlaps and reasons. Secondary results can be leads. No invented thresholds, causal edges, corrected values or historical versions.
representation_rule: Whole assertion replacement at fixed scope only for current core. Expose retraction, partial-field/scope changes and independent alternative support; do not coerce them into AND edges.
direct_corrections: Include every source-stated dependent correction in competent direct baselines. Redundant propagation is an admitted control property, not something to hide.
admission: Actual exact source representation, original/error evidence, same-authority correction, source-present essential dependency and unaffected control require separate review before model outputs. Passage-only work is a separately labelled task.
source_transport: One fresh bounded HTML probe of an already known public source. If standard authorized transfer works, freeze fresh capture batch; otherwise keep failure and proceed on supported work, without network-policy bypass.
